spec.name: sprint42_taker_imbalance_tail_liquidity_altbasket
spec.hypothesis: Extreme smoothed taker-buy imbalance (EFMA 2025 order-flow) predicts short-horizon continuation, concentrated in less-liquid, higher-turnover names (Liu-Tsyvinski cross-section, cited sprint18/26). Taker_imbalance failed on majors and liquid alts (sprints 10/12/13/19-23) but was never run on the tail-liquidity basket, the last empty cell of the signal x universe matrix.
spec.power_argument: Same 8-symbol tail basket and validation window as sprint26, which realized 4413 validation trades under identical caps, so n>=300 is near-certain even with BTCSTUSDT/MATICUSDT gaps. Per-trade stdev ~60bps (sprint21 back-solve); min detectable edge at n=300, t=2 ~6.9bps net, and PASS requires gross above the ~26bp T2 round-trip cost. Criteria can fail under the null: C0 random entries on this pipeline must net about -26bp.
